description: This Java class 'AccountTransferDetailAssembler' handles the assembly of account transfer details for various transfer types (savings to savings, savings to loan, loan to savings, loan to loan) within the Fineract platform. It interacts with repositories and assemblers to fetch account, client, and office data, and constructs transfer detail objects based on JSON commands.

classes.name: AccountTransferDetailAssembler
classes.description: Service class responsible for assembling account transfer details for various transfer scenarios within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Assembles transfer details for savings to savings transfer, extracting account and client info from JSON command.

methods.name: assembleSavingsToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Assembles transfer details for savings to loan transfer.

methods.name: assembleLoanToSavingsTransfer
methods.description: Assembles transfer details for loan to savings transfer.

methods.name: assembleLoanToLoanTransfer
methods.description: Assembles transfer details for loan to loan transfer.
